🌬️ Heard of Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV)?
This respiratory virus causes symptoms like fever, cough, & shortness of breath and can be severe for children & the elderly.
Stay informed! Learn more: 👉 https://t.co/ju5IEr2ArB 
#HMPVinInd
